lines.en: I cross the swamp on short legs.
The tusks by my mouth aren't long.
Mud comes over my ankles.
I root at the soil as I walk.

lines.zh: 我的身子很沉，像块石头。
lines.en: My body's heavy as stone.
I know these Triassic wetlands.
I press a path through the grass.

lines.zh: 我从泥洼里拔出一只脚。
lines.en: I pull one foot out of a wallow.
The hide on my neck is thick.
I pace slowly by the water.
I sniff the ground ahead.
A few of my kind are on the slope.
I stop and shake off the mud.
I slip a little but don't fall.
I keep my head down for shoots.
I step around a rotten log.
I stand in the mud, still.
My tusks press against my lip.
I'm chewing a tough stem.
Insects fly over the marsh.
I push my head into the mud.
Water runs off my back.
I snort, loudly.
My short legs sink in the mud.
I'm listening to birds.
I tilt my head and shake my ears.
Bubbles rise from the mud.

lines.zh: 钦利组的沼泽里，我泡着脚。
lines.en: In the Chinle marsh I soak my feet.

lines.zh: 有只小虫停在我鼻子上。
lines.en: A small fly lands on my nose.
You've stepped into my marsh.
I'm not tall, but I'm solid.
This is where my young and I live.
My tusks aren't sharp, but they'll do.
Step back and I'll lower my head.
I'm covered in mud.

lines.zh: 你站在我的地盘边上，别往前了。
lines.en: You're at the edge of my territory. Don't come closer.

lines.zh: 再盯着我看，我可要顶你了。
lines.en: Keep staring at me and I'll shove you with my tusks.
The mud steadies me.
I don't plan to give way.
I blow a low breath.
Its weight settles low.
I can still walk.

lines.zh: 谁敢碰我，我就用獠牙回敬！
lines.en: Touch me and my tusks will answer for me!

lines.zh: 疼！我的幼崽还在后头呢。
lines.en: That hurt! My calves are right behind me.

lines.zh: 这一下我记住了，你等着。
lines.en: I'll remember that blow. Just you wait.
You've got tender leaves.
That smells good.

lines.zh: 小块合弓类的鼻子，先动了。
lines.en: This dicynodont snout moves before I do.
This one's still tender.
I won't eat it muddy.
I nip off a tender tip.
Just hold still.

lines.zh: 那把嫩叶晃得我直咽口水。
lines.en: Those fresh leaves are making me drool.
You hit my shoulder.
I didn't give half a step.
The mud churns between us.
I turn on four short legs.

lines.zh: 喙一顶，你该知道让路了。
lines.en: One nudge of my beak and you should know to yield.
Some mud falls off me.

lines.zh: 我这身横肉，也不是白长的。
lines.en: This bulk of mine is not for nothing.
I lower my head once.
She's on the slope with the young.
She nuzzles my neck.
I push the tender leaves to her.
The young one hides between us.
We root at the soil together.
She calls once, briefly.
We walk into the mud side by side.
I block the wind with my body.
At night we lean together.
I take a stem in my mouth.
This root is tough.
I push it about.
Not grass; I put it down.
There's a stone in the mud.
This shoot is good.
I chewed twice.
It's stuck between my teeth.
I shake it loose.
I raise my thick neck.
I drop my head low.
It's too close to the young.
I press my head low.
Front foot first.
The mud slows me.
But it isn't fast either.
I'll use my shoulder.

lines.zh: 沼泽的水被我踩得四溅。
lines.en: The marsh water splashes under my feet.

lines.zh: 跟着那股味，我慢慢逼近。
lines.en: Following that smell, I close in slowly.
The mud holds my feet.
I go round a wallow.
Protecting my young, I do not yield a step.
I'm still following.
It's two steps closer.
My tusks point forward.
It backed onto dry ground.
I'm faster there.
It's run out of room.

lines.zh: 低下的头，是在量撞你的角度。
lines.en: My lowered head is measuring the angle to charge.
Two steps more.
There in a blink.
I butt it in the flank.
The hit turns it sideways.
My tusks rake across.
Mud flies everywhere.
It backs off several paces.
I slip too.
I stop and snort.
It goes down by the water.
I stop chasing it.
I look back at the young.
The mud is all our prints.

lines.zh: 沼泽里多了一团泥色的影子。
lines.en: A mud-coloured shape appears in the marsh.
My feet sink into the mud first.
These tusks of mine curve downward.
A few of my kind are far off.
Triassic air, same as ever.
I lower my head for a bite.
The bank is quiet.
I hear something in the water.
I walk slowly to the wallow.
I flatten a patch of grass.
I'm covered in mud.
I start rooting.

lines.zh: 火烧到我的厚皮，起了烟。
lines.en: Fire smokes on my thick hide.

lines.zh: 泥水灌进来，我拼命抬头。
lines.en: Muddy water floods in; I strain upward.

lines.zh: 一根尖东西进了我的厚皮。
lines.en: Something sharp goes into my thick hide.
Something holds me down.
So hungry I chew at the mud.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我四条腿都麻了。
lines.en: Lightning hits; all four legs go numb.
No mud below, and no water.
